newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Wednesday, dealers said.
Federal funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, the Fed's target for the rate, at the Fed's typical time for conducting open market operations.
The Fed added temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday via nine-day fixed system repurchase agreements, responding to a seasonal add need for the banking system.
(( -- Ellen Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
